<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>Nick Sangwa — Portfolio</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Serif+Display:ital@0;1&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  :root {
    --navy: #0a1628;
    --navy-mid: #122040;
    --navy-light: #1a3460;
    --gold: #c9a84c;
    --gold-light: #e8c97a;
    --cream: #f5f0e8;
    --cream-dark: #ede6d8;
    --white: #ffffff;
    --gray-text: #8a9ab5;
    --accent: #2a6fdb;
    --accent-light: #e8f0fc;
  }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--navy);
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* ── NAV ── */
  nav {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 1.1rem 3rem;
    background: rgba(10,22,40,0.96);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.2);
  }
  .nav-logo {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    color: var(--gold);
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }
  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2.2rem; list-style: none; }
  .nav-links a {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--gold); }

  /* ── HERO ── */
  .hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: var(--navy);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 7rem 3rem 4rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .hero::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -10%; right: -8%;
    width: 520px; height: 520px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(201,168,76,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .hero::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -15%; left: -5%;
    width: 380px; height: 380px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(42,111,219,0.10) 0%, transparent 70%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .hero-inner {
    max-width: 1100px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 5rem;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .hero-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.4);
    padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem;
    border-radius: 100px;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }
  .hero h1 {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 5vw, 4.2rem);
    line-height: 1.1;
    color: var(--white);
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  }
  .hero h1 em {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--gold);
  }
  .hero-subtitle {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    color: var(--gray-text);
    margin: 1.2rem 0 2rem;
    max-width: 400px;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
  .hero-cta {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .btn-primary {
    display: inline-block;
    background: var(--gold);
    color: var(--navy);
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    padding: 0.8rem 1.8rem;
    border-radius: 100px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gold-light); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .btn-outline {
    display: inline-block;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    padding: 0.8rem 1.8rem;
    border-radius: 100px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s;
  }
  .btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--gold); }

  /* Profile card */
  .profile-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.2);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 2.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
  }
  .avatar {
    width: 110px;
    height: 110px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--gold) 100%);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 2.6rem;
    color: var(--white);
    margin: 0 auto 1.3rem;
    border: 3px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.4);
  }
  .profile-card h3 {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--white);
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  }
  .profile-card p {
    color: var(--gold);
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }
  .contact-list { list-style: none; text-align: left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.7rem; }
  .contact-list li {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.7rem;
  }
  .contact-list li span.icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 28px; height: 28px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(201,168,76,0.15);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* ── SECTION DEFAULTS ── */
  section { padding: 5.5rem 3rem; }
  .section-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .section-label {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
  }
  .section-title {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
    line-height: 1.15;
    color: var(--navy);
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
  }

  /* ── ABOUT ── */
  .about-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 4rem;
    align-items: start;
  }
  .about-text p { font-size: 1rem; color: #3a4a60; line-height: 1.85; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .lang-pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.7rem; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
  .lang-pill {
    background: var(--navy);
    color: var(--white);
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 100px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .lang-pill span { color: var(--gold); margin-left: 0.4rem; font-weight: 300; font-size: 0.73rem; }

  /* Skill bars */
  .skill-bars { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.4rem; }
  .skill-item {}
  .skill-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 0.45rem; color: var(--navy); }
  .skill-header span { color: var(--gray-text); }
  .bar-track {
    height: 6px;
    background: var(--cream-dark);
    border-radius: 100px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .bar-fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 100px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--gold) 100%);
    animation: fillBar 1.2s ease forwards;
    transform-origin: left;
  }
  @keyframes fillBar { from { width: 0; } }

  /* ── EXPERIENCE ── */
  .exp-section { background: var(--navy); }
  .exp-section .section-title { color: var(--white); }
  .timeline { position: relative; padding-left: 2.5rem; }
  .timeline::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
    width: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--gold) 0%, rgba(201,168,76,0.1) 100%);
  }
  .timeline-item { position: relative; margin-bottom: 3rem; }
  .timeline-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .tl-dot {
    position: absolute;
    left: -2.8rem;
    top: 0.25rem;
    width: 14px; height: 14px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--gold);
    border: 3px solid var(--navy);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(201,168,76,0.25);
  }
  .tl-period {
    font-size: 0.73rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  }
  .tl-title {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    color: var(--white);
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
  }
  .tl-employer {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--gray-text);
    margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  .tl-desc {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    line-height: 1.7;
  }

  /* ── EDUCATION ── */
  .edu-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; }
  .edu-card {
    background: var(--white);
    border: 1px solid var(--cream-dark);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 1.8rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  }
  .edu-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(10,22,40,0.1); }
  .edu-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 3px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--gold));
  }
  .edu-year {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent);
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  }
  .edu-degree {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    color: var(--navy);
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  }
  .edu-inst { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--gray-text); }

  /* ── CERTIFICATIONS ── */
  .certs-section { background: var(--cream-dark); }
  .certs-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; }
  .cert-card {
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 2rem;
    display: flex;
    gap: 1.2rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    border: 1px solid rgba(10,22,40,0.08);
    transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  }
  .cert-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(10,22,40,0.08); }
  .cert-icon {
    width: 48px; height: 48px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: var(--navy);
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .cert-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: var(--gold); }
  .cert-body {}
  .cert-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
  .cert-issuer { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--gray-text); margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
  .cert-date {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-light);
    padding: 0.2rem 0.7rem;
    border-radius: 100px;
  }

  /* ── FOOTER ── */
  footer {
    background: var(--navy);
    padding: 3rem;
    text-align: center;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.2);
  }
  footer p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); font-size: 0.8rem; }
  footer strong { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 500; }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    nav { padding: 1rem 1.5rem; }
    .nav-links { gap: 1.2rem; }
    section { padding: 4rem 1.5rem; }
    .hero { padding: 6rem 1.5rem 3rem; }
    .hero-inner, .about-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2.5rem; }
    .hero::before, .hero::after { display: none; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav>

</nav>

</section>

<!-- ABOUT -->
<section id="about">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <div class="section-label">Profile</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">About Me</h2>
    <div class="about-grid">
      <div class="about-text">
        <p>
          I am a highly motivated and hardworking individual with a strong passion for technology and people. Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Software Engineering at Adventist University of Central Africa (AUCA), I combine academic learning with hands-on work experience in customer service and data operations.

          I am a creative problem-solver who thrives in team environments, always focused on achieving shared goals. My Cisco Networking Academy certifications reflect my commitment to continuous self-development in the technical space.

            <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:72%"></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="skill-item">
            <div class="skill-header"><span>Microsoft Office Suite</span><span>Proficient</span></div>
            <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:82%"></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="skill-item">
            <div class="skill-header"><span>Team Leadership</span><span>Strong</span></div>
            <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:85%"></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="skill-item">
            <div class="skill-header"><span>Data Modulation</span><span>Intermediate</span></div>
            <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:65%"></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="skill-item">
            <div class="skill-header"><span>Problem Solving</span><span>Strong</span></div>
            <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:88%"></div></div>

    </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- CERTIFICATIONS -->
<section class="certs-section" id="certifications">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <div class="section-label">Credentials</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Certifications</h2>
    <div class="certs-grid">
      <div class="cert-card">
        <div class="cert-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M12 2L2 7l10 5 10-5-10-5zM2 17l10 5 10-5M2 12l10 5 10-5"/></svg>
